lines.zh: 我在虚空上方滑行，触角先探路
lines.en: I glide above the void, antennae feeling ahead.

lines.zh: 末地石很冷，我贴着它掠过
lines.en: End stone is cold; I skim just above it.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，紫色的光跟着我
lines.en: I flick my tail and violet light trails me.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我也照样游
lines.en: There's no water here, yet I swim all the same.

lines.zh: 我绕着空岛边缘转，不敢太近
lines.en: I circle the island's rim, not daring too close.

lines.zh: 触角抖了一下，前面有东西
lines.en: My antennae twitch; something's ahead.

lines.zh: 别看我慢吞吞，一动起来很快
lines.en: Slow as I look, I can move very fast.

lines.zh: 黑色的虚空在下面，我往高处去
lines.en: The black void lies below; I climb higher.

lines.zh: 我穿过末地城的阴影，很安静
lines.en: I pass through the city's shadow, quietly.

lines.zh: 紫色的雾散开，我从里面出来
lines.en: Violet mist parts, and I come out of it.

lines.zh: 我贴着石柱滑过，翼没有碰到
lines.en: I slide past the pillar without touching.

lines.zh: 一整个岛都很空，只有一个我
lines.en: The whole island is empty but for me.

lines.zh: 我听见末影人的声音，绕开了
lines.en: I hear an Enderman and steer clear.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往上升，虚空就远了
lines.en: I rise slowly, and the void falls away.

lines.zh: 我顺着上升的气流，慢慢滑。
lines.en: I ride the rising air and glide slowly.

lines.zh: 触角碰到另一只，我停了停。
lines.en: My feeler touches another and I pause.

lines.zh: 末地的天没有云，只有我。
lines.en: No clouds in the End sky, only me.

lines.zh: 我绕着塔尖转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle half way around the tower tip.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，触角轻轻摆
lines.en: I hang in the air, antennae swaying.

lines.zh: 我用触角发了个信号，没人回
lines.en: I send a signal through my antennae; nothing answers.

lines.zh: 这里的风没有味道
lines.en: The wind here has no smell.

lines.zh: 我看着远处的紫雾发呆
lines.en: I stare at the violet haze far off.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一团，省力气
lines.en: I curl into myself to save strength.

lines.zh: 末地石上没有沙，我很不习惯
lines.en: There's no sand on the end stone; I'm not used to it.

lines.zh: 我又发了一次信号，还是没人
lines.en: I signal again, and still nobody answers.

lines.zh: 光从紫色的天上落下来，很淡
lines.en: Light falls from the violet sky, very faint.

lines.zh: 我听见自己翅膀的轻响
lines.en: I hear the soft sound of my own wings.

lines.zh: 我轻轻摆尾，什么也没发生
lines.en: I sway my tail gently, and nothing happens.

lines.zh: 虚空很安静，安静得发闷
lines.en: The void is quiet, quiet enough to smother.

lines.zh: 我在等一个回音，一直等
lines.en: I'm waiting for an answer, still waiting.

lines.zh: 我的触角碰到了空气里的电流
lines.en: My antennae brush a current in the air.

lines.zh: 这一片天归我，可我不太想要
lines.en: This sky is mine, though I hardly want it.

lines.zh: 你站在末地石上，我停下来看你
lines.en: You stand on the end stone; I stop to look.

lines.zh: 我的触角朝你伸了伸
lines.en: My antennae reach out toward you.

lines.zh: 你身上有主世界的味道
lines.en: You carry the smell of the overworld.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只是没见过
lines.en: I'm not afraid of you; I simply haven't seen your like.

lines.zh: 我绕着你慢慢飘了一圈
lines.en: I drift a slow circle around you.

lines.zh: 你在看我的触角吗
lines.en: Are you looking at my antennae?

lines.zh: 我试着给你发一个信号
lines.en: I try sending a signal your way.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在紫光里很亮
lines.en: Your eyes are bright in the violet light.

lines.zh: 我靠近了，又停在半路
lines.en: I come closer, then stop halfway.

lines.zh: 你抬起手，我把脑袋垂下来
lines.en: You lift a hand, and I dip my head low.

lines.zh: 它伤到我了，我发出一声低鸣
lines.en: It hurt me, and I let out a low cry.

lines.zh: 我的触角缩了起来，很疼
lines.en: My antennae curl in; it hurts.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次流血
lines.en: This is the first time I've bled.

lines.zh: 我往后退，退到虚空边上
lines.en: I back away, right to the void's edge.

lines.zh: 紫色的光暗了一截
lines.en: My violet light dims a notch.

lines.zh: 我的信号乱了，传不出去
lines.en: My signal scatters and won't carry.

lines.zh: 疼得我翅膀都在抖
lines.en: The pain makes my wings tremble.

lines.zh: 我本可以走，可我站在原地
lines.en: I could have left, yet I stayed put.

lines.zh: 这一下让我安静了很久
lines.en: That blow quieted me for a long while.

lines.zh: 我今天不想再靠近任何东西
lines.en: Today I don't want to come near anything again.

lines.zh: 那颗紫色的果子，有点香
lines.en: That purple fruit smells faintly sweet.

lines.zh: 你手里的光在闪，我跟着
lines.en: The light in your hand flickers; I follow.

lines.zh: 我也许能听懂你的信号
lines.en: Perhaps I can understand your signal.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我就靠近了
lines.en: You raise it high, and I come closer.

lines.zh: 这一点声音像同类
lines.en: That sound is almost like one of my kind.

lines.zh: 我在你身边绕，舍不得走
lines.en: I circle near you, unwilling to leave.

lines.zh: 那点紫光比虚空好看
lines.en: That violet glow is kinder than the void.

lines.zh: 我不饿，只是想凑近看看
lines.en: I'm not hungry; I just want a closer look.

lines.zh: 你往后挪，我就跟着飘过去
lines.en: You shuffle back, and I drift after you.

lines.zh: 这是很久以来第一个信号
lines.en: This is the first signal in a long time.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，触角先碰到的
lines.en: I bump you, antennae first.

lines.zh: 我的翼擦过石柱，掉了点灰
lines.en: My wing scrapes the pillar and sheds dust.

lines.zh: 虚空边上没有余地，我撞了你
lines.en: There's no room at the void's edge; I hit you.

lines.zh: 你退后，我反倒贴上去
lines.en: You step back, and I press closer instead.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在末地石上，很闷
lines.en: I knock into end stone; it's a dull thud.

lines.zh: 这里的风把我推向你
lines.en: The wind here pushes me into you.

lines.zh: 我很大，可我很轻
lines.en: I'm large, but I'm very light.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁也没受伤
lines.en: We collide, and neither is hurt.

lines.zh: 我的触角缠到了你的东西
lines.en: My antennae snag on your gear.

lines.zh: 撞完我退开，抱歉地摆尾
lines.en: After the bump I back off, tail apologizing.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，才等到另一个我
lines.en: I waited a long time for another of my kind.

lines.zh: 它用触角碰我的触角，我懂了
lines.en: It touches antenna to antenna, and I understand.

lines.zh: 我们的信号终于对上了
lines.en: Our signals finally matched.

lines.zh: 虚空这么大，我们还是遇见了
lines.en: The void is vast, and still we met.

lines.zh: 我们悬着不动，只用触角交谈
lines.en: We hang motionless, speaking only with antennae.

lines.zh: 它比我慢，我放慢了等它
lines.en: It's slower than me, so I slow down.

lines.zh: 这一刻总算有回音了
lines.en: At last there is an answer.

lines.zh: 我们一起上升，离虚空远些
lines.en: We rise together, away from the void.

lines.zh: 它的光比我的淡一点
lines.en: Its light is fainter than mine.

lines.zh: 聚在一起的时间很短
lines.en: Our time together is very short.

lines.zh: 有东西飘过来，我用触角碰了碰
lines.en: Something drifts by; I touch it with an antenna.

lines.zh: 我把它卷起来，又松开
lines.en: I curl around it, then let it go.

lines.zh: 这个东西会响，我喜欢
lines.en: This thing makes a sound, and I like it.

lines.zh: 它太沉，我提不起来
lines.en: It's too heavy for me to lift.

lines.zh: 末地石上掉的东西，我不管
lines.en: Things dropped on end stone, I leave them.

lines.zh: 我把它推到你脚边
lines.en: I push it to your feet.

lines.zh: 有一粒小小的光，我收下了
lines.en: A tiny grain of light; I keep it.

lines.zh: 我不需要这些，可我想拿着
lines.en: I don't need these, but I want to hold one.

lines.zh: 它滑走了，我追了一小段
lines.en: It slips away; I chase it a short way.

lines.zh: 我的触角比手好用
lines.en: My antennae serve better than hands.

lines.zh: 有什么从传送门里出来了
lines.en: Something has come through the portal.

lines.zh: 空气一震，我抬起头
lines.en: The air shudders, and I look up.

lines.zh: 它在动，而且比我快
lines.en: It's moving, and faster than I am.

lines.zh: 我第一次在这里感到危险
lines.en: For the first time here, I feel danger.

lines.zh: 触角收到了很乱的信号
lines.en: My antennae pick up a jumbled signal.

lines.zh: 那头有东西在等我过去
lines.en: Something over there is waiting for me.

lines.zh: 我该走了，可路只有一条
lines.en: I should go, but there's only one way.

lines.zh: 虚空在下面张着口
lines.en: The void gapes below.

lines.zh: 我的同类从不会这样靠近
lines.en: My own kind never came this close.

lines.zh: 这感觉不像信号，像警告
lines.en: This doesn't feel like a signal; it feels like a warning.

lines.zh: 我悬着不动，等它先动
lines.en: I hang still and let it move first.

lines.zh: 我把触角收了起来
lines.en: I draw my antennae in.

lines.zh: 它在往我这边来，一点一点
lines.en: It comes toward me, bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我算着到传送门还有多远
lines.en: I measure the distance to the portal.

lines.zh: 我的心跳在触角上能听见
lines.en: My pulse is audible through my antennae.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就往侧面滑
lines.en: The moment it moves, I slide sideways.

lines.zh: 我不想打，只想走
lines.en: I don't want to fight; I only want to leave.

lines.zh: 紫色的雾遮了我一半
lines.en: The violet haze hides half of me.

lines.zh: 它停住了，我也不动
lines.en: It stops, and I stop too.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，就没有退路了
lines.en: One step closer and there's no retreat.

lines.zh: 我用触角甩了它一下
lines.en: I whip it with an antenna.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，自己反而弹开
lines.en: I ram it and bounce off myself.

lines.zh: 我拍了下翅膀，风扫到它
lines.en: I beat my wings and the wind hits it.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打架，可我不能不还手
lines.en: I'm poor at fighting, but I can't just take it.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，我知道没用
lines.en: That was light, and I know it did nothing.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下，随即松了嘴
lines.en: I bite once, then let go immediately.

lines.zh: 尾巴横扫过去，只扫到空气
lines.en: My tail sweeps through and finds only air.

lines.zh: 它被我推退了一步
lines.en: It stumbles back a step from my push.

lines.zh: 我一边打一边往后退
lines.en: I fight while backing away.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次真正动手
lines.en: This is the first time I've truly struck.

lines.zh: 我从紫雾里凝出来，触角先动
lines.en: I condense out of the violet haze, antennae first.

lines.zh: 末地很静，我就这么出现了
lines.en: The End is silent, and there I am.

lines.zh: 我落在空岛边缘，差点滑下去
lines.en: I land on the island's rim and nearly slip.

lines.zh: 没有同类，只有我和虚空
lines.en: No kin here, only me and the void.

lines.zh: 我的身体还没定形
lines.en: My body hasn't settled into shape.

lines.zh: 第一缕光从我背上透出来
lines.en: The first light seeps out of my back.

lines.zh: 风把我托起来，我就留在半空
lines.en: The wind lifts me, and I stay aloft.

lines.zh: 我试着发了第一个信号
lines.en: I try sending my first signal.

lines.zh: 末地石凉得让我一颤
lines.en: The end stone's chill makes me shiver.

lines.zh: 这一趟，我大概要待很久
lines.en: I expect I'll be here a long while.

lines.zh: 火在这里没有落脚的地方
lines.en: Fire has nowhere to take hold here.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，越落越远
lines.en: I fall into the void, further and further.

lines.zh: 我不该在水里，触角全湿了
lines.en: I don't belong in water; my antennae are soaked.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把紫雾都吹散了
lines.en: The blast blows the violet haze apart.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的翼，我停在半空
lines.en: An arrow pins my wing, and I stall in midair.

lines.zh: 那股力一缠，信号全断了
lines.en: The force coils around me and every signal dies.

lines.zh: 末地没什么可吃，我越来越轻
lines.en: There's little to eat here; I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷在紫天上炸开，我眼睛发白
lines.en: Lightning bursts in the violet sky and whites out my eyes.

lines.zh: 虚空把我吞下去，连声音也没了
lines.en: The void swallows me, sound and all.
